root_cause.text: The X.509 certificate parser in `crypto/asymmetric_keys/x509_cert_parser.c` accesses the first byte of the extension buffer `v` in `x509_process_extension()` before validating that the extension length `vlen` is sufficient.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows that the length checks `if (vlen < 4)` and `if (vlen < 2)` were moved to execute before the buffer accesses `v[0] != ASN1_BTS` and `v[0] != (ASN1_CONS_BIT | ASN1_SEQ)` respectively, preventing an out-of-bounds read when parsing empty extensions.
